items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: I never would have known him. We called him Mickey. I never would have known it, because I never asked Mickey what the conversations were about.

ctx.x: That's funny, because Alvin told me that they must have sat next to each other in the section or something. Alan who? Alvin Alcorn.

Oh, well, he and Alvin were good friends, yes. Now, if he mentioned it, well, we called him, when you said Alvin, I never would have known him. We called him Mickey. I never would have known it, because I never asked Mickey what the conversations were about.
What about the band's own ideas when you got an arrangement? How much would you change them?
